title: Mountain Dining Plans: Enrolment Fee and Loading Limit Schedule
content:
The Mountain Dining Plans are opened against a one-off enrolment fee and then carry four limits on the money a household may put on them: the smallest amount that brings a plan into use, the smallest amount that may be added to it afterwards, the largest balance it may hold at any one moment, and the largest amount that may be loaded onto it across one season. The figures in force for each plan are those set out below.

## Enrolment fee and loading limits

| Plan | Enrolment fee | Smallest first load | Smallest later load | Largest balance at any moment | Largest loaded in one season |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | $0.00 | $100.00 | $25.00 | $1000.00 | $2000.00 |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | $0.00 | $250.00 | $50.00 | $2500.00 | $5000.00 |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | $25.00 | $500.00 | $100.00 | $6000.00 | $12000.00 |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | $95.00 | $1500.00 | $250.00 | $15000.00 | $30000.00 |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | $295.00 | $3500.00 | $500.00 | $35000.00 | $70000.00 |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | $950.00 | $9000.00 | $1000.00 | $90000.00 | $180000.00 |

The enrolment fee is the one-off fee for opening the plan. The smallest first load is the smallest amount the household must load to bring the plan into use; the smallest later load is the smallest amount that may be loaded once the first load has been made.

## Automatic top-up

Where a plan is offered with an automatic top-up, the plan also holds the balance at which that top-up is presented and the amount it loads. A plan sold without an automatic top-up holds neither figure.

| Plan | Automatic top-up | Balance at which it is presented | Amount it loads |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | not offered | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | offered | $25.00 | $100.00 |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | offered | $50.00 | $250.00 |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | offered | $150.00 | $750.00 |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | offered | $350.00 | $1750.00 |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | offered | $900.00 | $4500.00 |

## Notes on the two loading limits

The largest balance is measured at a single moment, while the largest season load is measured across the whole of the season, so a plan may stand well under the first limit and still have reached the second. Example, on hypothetical figures: a household on the Summit Table Dining Plan, whose largest balance is $6000.00 and whose largest season load is $12000.00, has loaded $12000.00 over the course of the season and spent most of it; the balance standing at that moment is $400.00, comfortably under the balance limit, and the season limit has nevertheless been reached in full.

Equally, the two smallest-load figures answer different moments: on the Alpine Club Dining Membership the first load must reach $1500.00, while a load made after the plan is in use need only reach $250.00.
